How to use Bobine

Content creators who publish every day, marketing teams who need dozens of consistent videos, small businesses with no editor, and journalists who must cut fast on a phone.

Open Bobine →Read the bookContact

WalkthroughMotion design, real screens

It plays by itself. Tap a dot or the arrows to move, Pause to stop.

01Get started

Five steps, five minutes.

1

Open bobine-tau.vercel.app. The site is French by default; the EN toggle is at the top.

2

Try the editor without an account from the Try link, or create an account to get one hundred free credits.

3

Create a new project: choose a format, drop your footage and, if you like, your own music.

4

Ask for the first cut. The agent plans, edits, reviews and repairs; it costs twenty credits.

5

Direct it by chat, export, and publish in 9:16 and 16:9 at once.

02Room by room

What is inside, and how to use it.

01The studio

The studio

Your home: projects, formats, agents, your music, and the sidebar to Cinéma, the book, the tour and the guide.

HOW TO USE IT

  1. New project from the sidebar
  2. Pick one of fifteen formats
  3. Add footage; it stays on your device
  4. Add music or take the sound of a clip
02The editor

The editor

The first cut appears with captions, titles, a look and music ducked under the voice. You direct changes by chat and the agent repairs its own mistakes.

HOW TO USE IT

  1. Watch the first cut
  2. Ask for changes in plain words
  3. Switch 9:16 and 16:9
  4. Export in HD or 4K on Pro
03Cinéma

Cinéma

Film AI scenes: write the scene, choose a look, a camera, a movement, light and colour, then shoot one to four takes.

HOW TO USE IT

  1. Open Cinéma and the tutorial on the first visit
  2. Describe the scene or start from a ready-made set-up
  3. Choose model, format and duration
  4. Download, or edit the take in Bobine
04The book and the guide

The book and the guide

Bobine, la méthode explains how to film for the cut. The guide covers every screen in fifty illustrated pages, in French and English, on the site or as a PDF.

HOW TO USE IT

  1. Open the guide from the sidebar
  2. Search a word or follow the parts in order
  3. Buy the book by card or with a code
  4. Read it on the site or download the PDF
05Plans and credits

Plans and credits

Découverte is free with one hundred credits. Créateur, Pro and Studio add credits, remove the watermark and open Cinéma and 4K. Local editing is free and unlimited.

HOW TO USE IT

  1. Open the credits page
  2. Pick a plan or a code pack
  3. Pay by card, or by cash and Mobile Money through the contact page
  4. Enter a code if you received one
03Tips
  • Film with the cut in mind: a wide shot, a detail, a face. The book explains why.
  • Give the agent your music; it cuts on the beats.
  • One format per project. A vlog and a launch are different edits.
  • Export both ratios every time; you will need the other one tomorrow.
04FAQ
Does my footage upload?

No. Editing and export run in your browser. Only the AI calls send small descriptions.

What does a cut cost?

Twenty credits for a first cut. A credit is about one US cent.

Can I pay in cash?

Yes, through the contact page: you pay, you receive a code.

Which languages?

French first, English one tap away.
